scope: Independent read-only evaluation on real forecast payloads; all feedback/ticket writes made only in a separate temporary SQLite database. No working journal inspected or altered.

checks.name: web_wording_distinguishes_observation_and_policy_availability
checks.detail: Root correction verified; API/store/rules sources unchanged since executed coverage audit.

limitations: No claim that deterministic advice identifies physical failure or improves forecast metrics.
Rules applied now to historical releases; generated_at is separate from issue_time and fact_cutoff.
Current catalog channel count is a reference denominator, not proof that every channel should send daily records.
Legacy/channel JSON modes have no new advice because their release context is not validated under this contract.
Native browser visual/HTTP testing belongs to root; this review used TestClient and static web reading.

resolved_findings.scope: Fallback policy rules, not triggered in these 468 cards
resolved_findings.message: The universal note says all grounds are observations through feature_cutoff. For fallback SELECTED_FOR_REVIEW/OUTSIDE_WARNING_POLICY, supporting warning is available at issue_time, correctly identified separately in API evidence. Prefer wording distinguishing observation cutoff from release policy time.
resolved_findings.resolution: Web note now separately states observation fact_cutoff and queue issue_time; verified in the current web source.
